text:
Maya: Quick note from cohort-3 onboarding (Enterprise A + B). I consolidated asks and recurring pain points — can we align on what to surface to PMs and what we can knock out as docs/enablement quick wins?

Ravi: Saw the list, thanks Maya. Short is best here.

Maya: Pasting the annotated list I sent to the onboarding spreadsheet earlier:
```
1) Per-route cost visibility — customers confused which routes inflate token spend (high impact, medium effort)
2) Webhook for model-fallback/runtime-degraded events — customers want alerts when we fall back to cheaper models (high impact, medium effort)
3) VPC onboarding step 4 (config + subnet examples) — many get stuck here (high impact, low effort)
4) UI toggle to prefer Dedicated vs Hosted routing per-route (medium impact, high effort)
5) Retry semantics/clarity on 429s and backoff (medium impact, low effort)
6) Embeddings freshness flag / last-updated metadata in responses (low-medium impact, medium effort)

Quick wins: add a one-paragraph guide for VPC step 4, and add an "expected throughput" field to the onboarding checklist so users know which Dedicated profile to request.
```

Jordan: This is great. Can CS do a 1-3 score for impact and effort for each item so PM can triage? 1=low, 3=high. Also include a couple of customer quotes.

Maya: Yep — will add scores + 2 anonymized quotes per item by EOD. Example quote for #1: "We see our cost spike but can't map it to a route — guesswork right now."

Eli: For #2 (webhook) we can prototype a minimal event: 
```
POST /hooks/onFallback
{ "customer_id": "C123", "timestamp": 1670000000, "fallback_model": "gpt-small" }
```
If PM likes it, we can ship a beta within ~3 sprints.

Tasha: I can own the VPC step-4 doc. Will draft and post a short checklist + subnet example this afternoon.

Ravi: On prioritization — suggest we surface 1,2,3 to PMs as top candidates. 4 is large and needs product roadmap slot. 5 and 6 can be follow-ups or part of Improve Observability epic.

Maya: Agree. Adding the scoring now.

onboard-bot: ticket created — CS-4782 (VPC doc), CS-4783 (per-route cost ask), CS-4784 (webhook fallback proto).

Jordan: Thanks. Once scores + quotes are in, I'll slot CS-4783 and CS-4784 into the next discovery cycle.

Maya: Done — uploaded scores + two quotes per item to the onboarding spreadsheet and linked in the PM doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4783 (private)

Eli: :thumbsup: I'll start a repo stub for the webhook proto and link to the ticket.

Tasha: Draft is up — short checklist + subnet snippets in the doc, asking for CS review.

Maya: Awesome team. Follow-ups: Ravi to shepherd PM sync, Eli to drop proto stub, Tasha to finalize doc. I'll ping again after the PM triage. :eyes:

Ravi: On it.

Jordan: Appreciate the rapid loop.
